updates.summary: The distance that is considered “deep gas” has been reduced by 30% in Resurgence.

updates.summary: Increased the number of HDKs that need to blow up before another HKD killstreak can be called in from 1 to 2.

updates.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 04 Reloaded Patch Notes
updates.summary: Squads earn points through eliminations, advancing to the next weapon tier every five eliminations, with the first team to cycle through all 10 weapons claiming victory.

updates.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 04 Patch Notes

updates.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 03 Reloaded Patch Notes
updates.summary: This update focuses on underutilized attachments, with adjustments aimed at increasing overall build diversity and encouraging players to explore new options.

updates.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Season 03 Patch Notes
